opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submission; must hold an independent research post; must not hold another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support. Undergraduate Student Members, Affiliates and Partner Scientists not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports RSC members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Provides up to £5,000 for 12 months for chemicals/equipment, consumables, specialist software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account), or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; not resubmit an unsuccessful application unless invited; applications must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based engagement and outreach projects that connect communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences, including public engagement, school engagement, and projects for under-represented audiences. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Partner Scientist, Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) at submission and for the grant duration; PhD students or researchers in the chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education. Undergraduate Student Members and Affiliates not eligible. Partner Scientists must have been members for at least 180 days.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists in industry and academia to undertake activities that support their research career, such as conference participation, training courses and networking. Up to £500 per activity. Round 4 opens 14 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submission and for the grant duration; PhD students or researchers at any career stage, in any sector or location. Undergraduate Student Members, Affiliates and Partner Scientists not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers to establish and develop national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations and networks, including research visits to collaborators' institutions and organising meetings/workshops. Up to £5,000. Round 2 open until 21 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be chemists; based in the UK or Ireland or, if outside these countries, hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers with up to £1,200 per year to cover additional costs of care they usually provide while attending chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund. Rolling applications.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be chemists; based in the UK or Ireland or, if outside these countries, hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will use funds to cover the cost of support or assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports chemists with disabilities and ongoing health conditions with up to £1,200 per year to cover extra costs of specific support (e.g. accessible travel, personal assistance, communication support, assistive software/hardware) to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund. Rolling applications.
